paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者回忆一次原本期待的普通通话没有按时开始，自己感到担心，却不知道对方当时为何没空。另一次联系间隔中，他又能暂时保留未知。这些体验可以并存，不能据此判断谁更重视关系、谁有义务立即回应，或哪段联结更安全。指南没有读取消息，也不要求重新联系、查看活动或测试承诺。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls worry when an expected ordinary call did not begin on time, without knowing why the other person was unavailable. During another gap, the reader could leave uncertainty open. Both experiences can remain without judging who values the connection more, who owes an immediate reply or which connection is safer. The guide reads no messages and requests no renewed contact, activity check or promise test.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想描述的是自己的担心；对方的情况我还不知道；哪些细节要分享由我决定。”可以只讨论虚构例子，不报自己的记录。听者可以了解感受，不必替对方解释动机、作保证或证明关系；分享公开指南也不代表向谁提出联系要求。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can name the reader’s worry, leave the other person’s circumstances unknown and keep disclosure voluntary. Discuss only the fictional scene without your record if preferred. A listener can hear the feeling without supplying motives, guarantees or proof about the connection. Sharing the public guide makes no request for contact.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是干预或测量证据。原21句、七份各三条的六类记录保持不变，无法判断、无经历与不答分别保留，不转成不符合。自在与困难不反向、不合分，不派主要模式、人格或临床类别。四周只提示回忆；信效度、常模与跨语言等价尚未建立。全文无需作答，支持不设计数门槛；公开分享只含标题与入口，不含回答、计数或私人经历。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not an intervention or measurement evidence. The twenty-one statements and seven six-category records of three stay unchanged. Cannot judge, no experience and withholding remain separate from does not describe. Comfortable and difficult descriptions are neither reversed nor combined into a dominant pattern, personality or clinical category. Four weeks is a recall aid, without established reliability, validity, norms or language equivalence. Full guides require no answers and support has no count threshold. Public sharing contains only the title and entry, without answers, counts or private experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者在一次共同安排中感到失望，回忆里对同伴的整体印象也随之改变，同时仍记得先前一次愉快合作。两段回忆不要求拼成一个好人或坏人的结论，保留复杂印象也不是考试目标。指南不能核对互动事实或裁定哪种看法准确；无需重开分歧、让同伴自证或决定关系去留。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls disappointment during a shared plan, a changed overall impression of a companion and an earlier pleasant collaboration. The memories need not resolve into a good-or-bad verdict about a person; keeping a mixed impression is no test target. The guide cannot check the exchange or adjudicate accuracy. It requires no reopened disagreement, proof from the companion or decision about continuing the connection.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡可以区分“一次互动的感受”“整体印象是否改变”“仍然不知道的背景”。这张虚构卡不邀请朋友给当事人贴标签，也不让类别最多的一项替代实际经历。可以只阅读，不作评价或联系；自己的细节和记录可继续保留。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can distinguish the feeling in one interaction, a change in overall impression and background still unknown. This fictional card invites no labels for anyone and lets no largest category replace an actual experience. Reading requires no verdict or contact; personal details and records can stay private.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls describing careful work in a professional introduction, mentioning enjoyable activities among familiar people and being unsure on another occasion what mattered to them. Different descriptions and uncertainty can coexist without choosing one true version or inferring a hidden identity. The guide favours no role and requests no value list, announced preference or demonstration of consistency.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我在这个场合用了这样的描述；它不必覆盖我的全部；有些问题我还没想清。”可以只谈卡中的虚构人物，不要求听者确认你是谁。用词改变不自动成为矛盾，暂时清楚也不必变成固定标签；不答仍可阅读同样全文。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can describe words used in one setting without making them a whole-person account, while leaving some questions unfinished. Discuss the fictional person without asking a listener to confirm who you are. Changed wording need not become a contradiction and momentary clarity need not become a fixed label. Withholding answers leaves the same full guide available.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls quickly changing colours for a weekend craft activity while excited, then wishing they had considered it longer. Regret need not become evidence of dangerousness, and a small plan describes no entire decision history. The guide knows neither consequences, available time nor whether waiting would have helped. The scene requests no new decision, delay or repeated comparison.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡只区分“当时记得的感受”“那个普通选择”“目前不确定的结果”。可以只读虚构卡，不补充风险行为或私人细节，也不让听者替你评冲动程度。真实且后果重要的决定按其实际情况处理，不用本记录作为许可、限制或能力证明。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a remembered feeling, the ordinary choice and outcomes still uncertain. Read the fictional card without risky-act or private details and without asking a listener to rate impulsivity. Real decisions with important consequences need their actual circumstances considered; this record provides no permission, restriction or proof of capacity.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者回忆一次普通计划讨论后，感受由轻松转为紧张，却说不清转换经过，也不确定强度是不是超过自己的预期。感受改变、强度和难以描述是不同信息，可分别保留。指南不把先后当成原因，不由此命名发作或诊断；不要求重新谈一遍、计时或逐次追踪情绪。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a shift from ease to tension after discussing an ordinary plan, cannot describe the transition and is unsure whether its intensity exceeded expectations. Change, intensity and difficulty describing it are different information that can stay separate. The guide treats no sequence as a cause and names no episode or diagnosis. No repeated discussion, timing or emotion tracking is required.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我能说出前后有变化；中间发生了什么仍不清楚；现在想谈的是它对日常的影响。”听者可以接住这份未知，不必立即寻找触发原因或要求画出完整过程。卡片可只读，不增加监测任务，也不以恢复得快慢比较人。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can name a remembered change, leave its transition unclear and focus on a current effect in daily life. A listener can accept uncertainty without immediately finding a trigger or asking for a complete sequence. The card is optional reading, adds no monitoring task and compares no one by speed of returning to another feeling.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者参与一次普通拼图活动时，回忆自己的感受有些空荡；另一个安静片刻，他又不确定该叫休息、麻木还是空虚。两种描述不需要互相解释，参与活动也不证明没有这种感受。指南不决定他缺少什么，不安排新挑战、独处或寻刺激来验证这个词。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls feeling somewhat empty during an ordinary jigsaw activity, then being unsure whether another quiet moment felt restful, numb or empty. The descriptions need not explain each other; participation does not disprove a private feeling. The guide identifies no missing need and prescribes no challenge, isolation or stimulation to verify a word.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡可以说：“这个词只接近我的感受；我还不知道原因；细节暂时不展开。”也可以只讨论虚构示例，不要求自己必须认同“空虚”。听者无需替你找缺陷、目标或关系解释；实际困扰可以被听见，不需先说清词义或填满三条。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can use a word provisionally, keep the cause unknown and leave details private. Discuss the fictional example without requiring yourself to identify with emptiness. A listener need not supply a deficit, purpose or relationship explanation. An actual concern can be heard without first defining the word or completing all three statements.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls strong anger during an ordinary scheduling disagreement, a sense of choice about replying and attention lingering afterwards. All three descriptions can remain: perceived choice cancels no anger and proves no particular response was used. The guide reconstructs no consequences and judges no person’s safety. It calls for no contact, reopened dispute or provoked anger.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡区分“感到什么”“注意停在哪里”“实际行为仍需按事实单独考虑”。可以只读这张虚构卡，不复述事件，也不让听者用选择感或低计数否定实际顾虑。卡片不决定如何处理冲突；若想讨论支持，可以从当前困难说起，不用记录作证。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a feeling, where attention lingered and actual behaviour requiring its own facts. Read the fictional card without recounting an incident or letting perceived choice or low counts dismiss a real concern. The card decides no conflict response. A supportive conversation can begin with the current difficulty without using a record as proof.
